messages:
Mariam: autoscaler alert: provisioning queue > 120s for eu-west-1-gpu, pods stuck in ContainerCreating with AttachNetworkInterface failures. Seen a spike in research-batch namespace. Can we confirm ENI/eni-attach limits?

ops-bot: [AUTO] cluster-autoscaler: scaleUp triggered for nodegroup research-gpu-spot (req: 6 -> want: 12) :warning:

Ethan: looking now. `kubectl get pods -n research-batch -o wide | grep Pending` shows ~47 Pending on 3 different nodepools. Most failing with `AttachNetworkInterface: Resource limit exceeded`.

Jules: confirmed. AWS quota exhaustion on eni-per-instance for that nodegroup type. region shows ENI allocation at 98%. This explains ContainerCreating hang.

Leo: immediate mitigation idea: evict lower-priority noise in research-batch, and move long-running hyperparam jobs to a quota-limited queue. Can we patch priorityclass?

Mariam: yes patching priorities now. Running: ```kubectl -n research-batch get pod -o json | jq '.items[] | select(.metadata.labels["tier"]=="best-effort") | .metadata.name' | xargs -r -n1 kubectl -n research-batch delete pod``` Doing a rolling eviction of best-effort to free ENI attachments.

Priya: also adding temporary taint on research-gpu nodegroup to stop new scheduling there: ```kubectl taint nodes -l nodepool=research-gpu node.kubernetes.io/eni-guard=:NoSchedule-``` Will remove when stable.

Ethan: started creating a transient nodegroup (research-burst-eni) in a subnet with spare ENI headroom using `eksctl create nodegroup --name research-burst-eni --instance-types p4d.24xlarge --max-pods-per-node 50` — this gives us more attachable interfaces per node. ETA ~7m.

ops-bot: [AUTO] new nodegroup research-burst-eni creation started by Ethan.

Jules: note: p4d has high ENI density but high cost. This is emergency only :money_with_wings:

Leo: while burst nodes come up, enable prefix delegation cache on the runtime to reduce ephemeral network attachments for sidecars. Short term change: set env REDWOOD_ENABLE_PREFIX_CACHE=true in inference runtime config for research namespace.

Mariam: burst nodes registered, kubelets ready. Draining some cramped spot nodes to free up subnets: `kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` and letting CA scale down.

infra-bot: [INFO] autoscaler observed scale-up -> 6 additional nodes joined. Pending pod count dropped from 47 -> 8. AttachNetworkInterface errors cleared for new pods.

Ethan: confirmed pods moving into Running on research-burst-eni. Starting to cancel large low-priority jobs from the queue: `rbacctl cancel-job --selector=batch=hpsearch --dry-run` then `--force` after validation.

Priya: creating incident ticket INC-2026-891 and assigning follow-ups: limit increase request to cloud (AWS ENI-per-instance + VPC ENI quotas), infra work to add ENI-aware binpacking to scheduler, product change to cap per-team burst.

Mariam: postmortem action items: 1) request quota adjustments (who: Jules) 2) add quota-aware admission controller to avoid large bursty launches (who: Ethan) 3) add docs for researchers about safe-job launch flags + default priorityclass (who: Priya) 4) consider dedicated research-gpu nodegroup with larger ENI headroom (who: Leo).

Leo: cost note — temporary p4d nodes ~¥20k/day. capture cost impact in INC-2026-891.

Mariam: incident now in mitigated state. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours then update status to resolved. Thanks all :bow:
